purpose_note: Record of a reproduction attempt for a bug composition. 'Reproduce first' is named in the bug flow and in prompts/plan.md but is otherwise unenforceable, because nothing records that a reproduction happened, what it produced, or that it failed for the defect. Build may not begin without a repro record carrying at least one case with fails_for_defect true. reproduced true with no case-level received value is rejected.
reproduction_kind_vocabulary: test | command | product_walkthrough | log_replay. Record what was actually driven, not what would have been ideal.
fails_for_defect_note: fails_for_defect is deliberately distinct from 'the test failed'. A test that errors on a missing module, a bad import, a misconfigured fixture or an unavailable service also fails, and none of those is a reproduction. Set it true only when the recorded received value differs from expected for the defect under investigation; record the observed failure_mode so a reviewer can check that judgement rather than take it. expected and received hold the actual values, not a description of them: on the real run these were what the reviewer checked. forced_condition names any condition induced to reach the defect (a forced error response, a killed process, an injected delay) and stays null for a naturally occurring reproduction.
coverage_audit_note: The tests-that-cannot-fail check. For every existing test being counted as coverage for this defect, record whether it can actually distinguish the broken state from the fixed one. On the real run an existing test was found whose before and after values were equal by construction: it passed in both states, proved nothing, and had been counted as coverage anyway. can_distinguish_states true requires evidence, which is normally the differing values the test would observe in each state, or the observation that it fails against the unfixed revision. A test that cannot distinguish the two states is not coverage and must not be counted as any.
next_action: record at least one case with fails_for_defect true, or report blocked with the reason the defect could not be reproduced
